function.name: impl_from_IRunningObjectTable
function.description: This function returns the containing record of the given interface in the RunningObjectTableImpl structure.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRunningObjectTable interface

function.return_type: RunningObjectTableImpl pointer, representing the containing record of the given interface

function.name: impl_from_IEnumMoniker
function.description: This function returns a pointer to the EnumMonikerImpl structure that contains the given IEnumMoniker interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IEnumMoniker interface.

function.return_type: EnumMonikerImpl pointer, representing the containing record of the given IEnumMoniker interface pointer.

function.name: create_stream_on_mip_ro
function.description: This function creates a stream on a memory block, copies data into it and returns the stream.

parameters.name: mip
parameters.description: Pointer to the InterfaceData structure that contains the data to be copied into the stream

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IStream interface on which the function creates a new stream object

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code

function.name: rot_entry_delete
function.description: This function deletes a rot_entry object. It frees the memory allocated for the object, its moniker_data and object fields. If the object's cookie field is not null, it revokes the cookie, frees the memory allocated for the object and moniker returned by the revoke operation, and releases the marshalled data if a stream could be created on the moniker. If the object's object field is not null, it releases the marshalled data if a stream could be created on the object.

parameters.name: rot_entry
parameters.description: Pointer to the rot_entry object to be deleted

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: get_moniker_comparison_data
function.description: This function retrieves comparison data for a given moniker. If the moniker supports IROTData, it uses that to retrieve the comparison data. If not, it generates comparison data from the moniker's display name.

parameters.name: pMoniker
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface on the moniker for which to get comparison data.

parameters.name: moniker_data
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a MonikerComparisonData structure. This structure receives the comparison data.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is insufficient memory, or other standard COM error codes.

function.name: reduce_moniker
function.description: This function reduces a moniker using the IMoniker_Reduce method. If the provided bind context is null, it creates a new one. It also handles the release of the newly created bind context.

parameters.name: pmk
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to be reduced

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context. If this is null, a new bind context is created

parameters.name: pmkReduced
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the reduced moniker will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns the error code

function.name: RunningObjectTableImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface of the running object table implementation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRunningObjectTable interface.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier (IID).

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, and E_NOINTERFACE if not. It also returns E_INVALIDARG if the ppvObject argument is invalid.

function.name: RunningObjectTableImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function traces the interface and returns the value 2.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IRunningObjectTable interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the constant value 2 in this context.

function.name: RunningObjectTableImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases an interface from the running object table.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface to be released from the running object table.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the status of the operation, in this case always returns 1 indicating success.

function.name: RunningObjectTableImpl_Register
function.description: This function registers an object and its moniker in the running object table (ROT). It also provides a unique identifier for the registered object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRunningObjectTable interface

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags controlling the registration

parameters.name: punkObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the object to be registered

parameters.name: pmkObjectName
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker of the object to be registered

parameters.name: pdwRegister
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD variable which receives the unique identifier for the registered object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds; otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: RunningObjectTableImpl_Revoke
function.description: This function revokes a registration for a running object. It searches for the registration in the running object table and if found, removes it and deletes the entry.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRunningObjectTable interface of the running object to be revoked.

parameters.name: dwRegister
parameters.description: The registration key of the running object.

function.return_type: HRESULT. Returns S_OK if the function successfully revokes the running object, otherwise returns E_INVALIDARG if the registration key is not found.

function.name: RunningObjectTableImpl_IsRunning
function.description: This function checks if the given object is running in the running object table. It does this by comparing the moniker data of the object with the entries in the running object table.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the running object table.

parameters.name: pmkObjectName
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker of the object to check.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the object is running, S_FALSE otherwise.

function.name: RunningObjectTableImpl_GetObject
function.description: This function retrieves an object from the Running Object Table (ROT) using a moniker. It also handles the case when the moniker is not available locally and needs to be fetched from the SCM.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the Running Object Table.

parameters.name: pmkObjectName
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker of the object to be retrieved.

parameters.name: ppunkObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the retrieved object's IUnknown interface pointer will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where a successful operation returns S_OK and an unsuccessful operation returns a failure code. E_POINTER is returned if ppunkObject is NULL.

function.name: RunningObjectTableImpl_NoteChangeTime
function.description: This function updates the last modified time of a registered object in the running object table.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of the running object table.

parameters.name: dwRegister
parameters.description: The registration key of the object in the running object table.

parameters.name: pfiletime
parameters.description: Pointer to the new last modified time to be set for the object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if the object is not found in the running object table, otherwise it returns the result of the InternalIrotNoteChangeTime function.

function.name: RunningObjectTableImpl_GetTimeOfLastChange
function.description: This function retrieves the time of the last change to the specified object in the running object table (ROT).

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRunningObjectTable interface.

parameters.name: pmkObjectName
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface that represents the object name.

parameters.name: pfiletime
parameters.description: Pointer to a FILETIME structure that receives the object's last change time.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where a successful return is S_OK and any other value indicates failure. It represents the status of the function call.

function.name: RunningObjectTableImpl_EnumRunning
function.description: This function enumerates the running object table and creates an enumeration of monikers.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of the running object table.

parameters.name: ppenumMoniker
parameters.description: Double pointer to an enumeration of monikers.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: GetRunningObjectTable
function.description: This function retrieves the Running Object Table (ROT) for the current process, checks if the process is initialized, and increments the reference count of the ROT.

parameters.name: reserved
parameters.description: This parameter is reserved and must be zero.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to the IRunningObjectTable interface. On successful return, *ret contains the requested interface pointer to the ROT.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the process is not initialized, it returns CO_E_NOTINITIALIZED. If the reserved parameter is not zero, it returns E_UNEXPECTED.

function.name: DestroyRunningObjectTable
function.description: This function destroys the running object table by entering a critical section, iterating over each entry in the table, removing the entry and deleting it, and then leaving the critical section.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, meaning it does not return anything.

function.name: get_moniker_for_progid_display_name
function.description: This function gets a moniker for a given program identifier display name. It handles memory allocation, class ID retrieval, moniker creation, and object binding, with error checking at each step.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context interface

parameters.name: szDisplayName
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name string

parameters.name: pchEaten
parameters.description: Pointer to the number of characters parsed in the display name

parameters.name: ppmk
parameters.description: Pointer to the resulting moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns MK_E_SYNTAX if the syntax is incorrect, or the result of the moniker creation and binding operations.

function.name: MkParseDisplayName
function.description: This function parses a display name and returns a moniker that represents it.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context used in this operation

parameters.name: szDisplayName
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name to be parsed

parameters.name: pchEaten
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the number of characters successfully parsed in szDisplayName

parameters.name: ppmk
parameters.description: Address of IMoniker pointer variable that receives the interface pointer to the resulting moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code.

function.name: GetClassFile
function.description: This function attempts to retrieve the CLSID associated with a given file. It first checks if the file contains a storage object and returns the CLSID written by IStorage_SetClass method. If the file is not a storage object, it attempts to match various bits in the file against a pattern in the registry. If these strategies fail, it searches for the extension key in the registry.

parameters.name: filePathName
parameters.description: The path of the file to get the CLSID from.

parameters.name: pclsid
parameters.description: Pointer to the CLSID associated with the file.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_OK if the function is successful, MK_E_INVALIDEXTENSION if the file extension is not valid or not found in the registry, or other error codes as defined by the HRESULT type.

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface of a moniker enumerator. It checks if the requested interface (identified by riid) is supported, and if so, returns a pointer to it in ppvObject.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumMoniker interface of the moniker enumerator

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: If the interface is supported, a pointer to it is returned in this parameter

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if the interface is not supported, and E_INVALIDARG if ppvObject is NULL

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the EnumMonikerImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumMoniker interface of the EnumMonikerImpl object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the increment.

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the IEnumMoniker interface, decrements the reference count, and if there are no more references, it uninitializes the ROT structure and frees the memory allocated for the moniker list and the interface itself.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumMoniker interface to be released

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the release operation

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_Next
function.description: This function retrieves the requested number of moniker from the current position.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for enumeration of the monikers.

parameters.name: celt
parameters.description: Number of elements in the enumeration sequence to return.

parameters.name: rgelt
parameters.description: Pointer to an array to receive the interfaces requested in the enumeration sequence.

parameters.name: pceltFetched
parameters.description: Pointer to a location that receives the actual number of elements enumerated.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. S_OK if the function was successful, S_FALSE if not all elements could be enumerated, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_Skip
function.description: This function skips a certain number of elements in a moniker list.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the enumeration object

parameters.name: celt
parameters.description: The number of elements to be skipped

function.return_type: HRESULT, where S_OK represents successful completion and S_FALSE indicates that there are not enough elements to skip

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_Reset
function.description: This function resets the position of the EnumMonikerImpl object back to the start of the list.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IEnumMoniker interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful.

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_Clone
function.description: This function clones an enumeration of monikers, which are objects that provide a pointer to other objects, allowing the same object to be accessed multiple times.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the enumeration of monikers to be cloned

parameters.name: ppenum
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer, where the cloned enumeration of monikers will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is not enough memory to complete the operation.

function.name: EnumMonikerImpl_CreateEnumROTMoniker
function.description: This function creates an enumeration of Component Object Model (COM) monikers from a list of interfaces, starting at a specified position.

parameters.name: moniker_list
parameters.description: Pointer to the list of interfaces from which the enumeration is created.

parameters.name: current_pos
parameters.description: The position in the list where the enumeration should start.

parameters.name: ppenumMoniker
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the IEnumMoniker interface on the enumeration object that this function creates.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents whether the function was successful or not. It returns S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if the ppenumMoniker argument is NULL, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is insufficient memory to create the enumeration object.

function.name: impl_from_IUnknown
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface for which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: MonikerMarshal, which represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: impl_from_IMarshal
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: MonikerMarshal, which represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: MonikerMarshalInner_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface and returns a pointer to that interface if it is supported.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface to be queried.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of the pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppv contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppv will contain NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_OK if the interface is supported, and E_NOINTERFACE if not.

function.name: MonikerMarshalInner_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the MonikerMarshal object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IUnknown interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: MonikerMarshalInner_Release
function.description: This function releases the MonikerMarshal object and decrements the reference count. If the reference count is zero, it frees the memory allocated for this object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the IUnknown interface of the MonikerMarshal object.

function.return_type: ULONG, it represents the new reference count of the MonikerMarshal object after it has been decremented.

function.name: MonikerMarshal_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface of a MonikerMarshal object and returns the interface if it is available.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMarshal interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation. If the interface is successfully retrieved, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code.

function.name: MonikerMarshal_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to a MonikerMarshal object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMarshal interface

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the MonikerMarshal object

function.name: MonikerMarshal_Release
function.description: This function releases the MonikerMarshal object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMarshal interface

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the MonikerMarshal object

function.name: MonikerMarshal_GetUnmarshalClass
function.description: This function retrieves the CLSID of the unmarshaler that will be used when an object is unmarshaled from a buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMarshal interface.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface to be unmarshaled.

parameters.name: pv
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer from which the object is to be unmarshaled.

parameters.name: dwDestContext
parameters.description: The destination context where the unmarshaled object will be run.

parameters.name: pvDestContext
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination context.

parameters.name: mshlflags
parameters.description: Indicates the reason for marshaling the interface.

parameters.name: pCid
parameters.description: Pointer to the CLSID of the unmarshaler.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns the standard values E_OUTOFMEMORY, E_UNEXPECTED, E_FAIL, or the standard self-registrable UnMarshaler errors.

function.name: MonikerMarshal_GetMarshalSizeMax
function.description: This function retrieves the size, in bytes, of the stream needed to marshal the object pointed to by the IMoniker pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMarshal interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface to be marshaled

parameters.name: pv
parameters.description: Pointer to the object to be marshaled

parameters.name: dwDestContext
parameters.description: Destination context for marshaling

parameters.name: pvDestContext
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination context

parameters.name: mshlflags
parameters.description: Indicates the type of marshaling being used

parameters.name: pSize
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable that receives the size of the stream needed to marshal the object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_OK if successful

function.name: MonikerMarshal_MarshalInterface
function.description: This function marshals interfaces of a MonikerMarshal object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface to be marshaled.

parameters.name: pStm
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream where the marshaled interface is to be written.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface to be marshaled.

parameters.name: pv
parameters.description: Pointer to the object to be marshaled.

parameters.name: dwDestContext
parameters.description: Destination context for the marshaled data.

parameters.name: pvDestContext
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination context.

parameters.name: mshlflags
parameters.description: Flags controlling the marshaling process.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the marshaling operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK.

function.name: MonikerMarshal_UnmarshalInterface
function.description: This function unmarshals an interface from a stream, using the IMoniker interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMarshal interface

parameters.name: pStm
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStream interface from which the object is to be marshaled

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface to be unmarshaled

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if successful

function.name: MonikerMarshal_ReleaseMarshalData
function.description: This function is used to release marshal data for a moniker. However, it does not actually release anything as there is nothing on the server side to release.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the marshal

parameters.name: pStm
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream where the marshal data is stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns S_OK indicating success.

function.name: MonikerMarshal_DisconnectObject
function.description: This function is used to disconnect a state-based marshal. However, it doesn't actually disconnect anything because there's nothing on the server side to disconnect from.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the marshal that is to be disconnected

parameters.name: dwReserved
parameters.description: Reserved for future use

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns S_OK indicating the operation is successful

function.name: MonikerMarshal_Create
function.description: This function creates a MonikerMarshal object and initializes its members. It also allocates memory for the new object.

parameters.name: inner
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface that the MonikerMarshal object will use.

parameters.name: outer
parameters.description: Address of a pointer to an IUnknown interface. This function will set the pointer to the IUnknown interface of the new MonikerMarshal object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds or an error code if it fails.

function.name: MIDL_user_allocate
function.description: This function allocates memory of a specified size.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the size of the memory to be allocated.

function.return_type: void pointer, representing the starting address of the allocated memory.

function.name: MIDL_user_free
function.description: This function frees the memory space pointed to by the parameter.

parameters.name: p
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the memory space that needs to be freed.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value.
